candidateContents.tickets: DEV-083 implemented, tested, merged to master (bbbb932); version bump to 0.0.25 in 8b56ac4
highlights: DEV-083: .nexnote/config.json and .nexnote/layout.json are no longer versioned into git (ADR-0016 supersedes ADR-0003 allowlist). UI/layout state is per-device only; existing vaults get a one-time git rm --cached migration in ensureSyncGuard.
DEV-083: vault:saveLayout IPC no longer calls scheduleAutoCommit. Layout-only debounced writes are also skipped when the diff is empty (no spurious commits).

DEV-083: new doctor repair action 'preserve-local-and-abort' is the new default when a rebase/merge is paused. It uses git format-patch to export ahead commits to .nexnote/.rebase-recovery/<ts>/, then git rebase --abort, then git am --3way to replay patches one at a time. Failed patches are quarantined to FAILED/ inside the recovery directory — never silently lost.

DEV-083: secondary doctor action 'force-abort-rebase-or-merge' exposed only as a destructive second button (red border, explicit 'drop ahead commits' label) for users who genuinely want to discard local notes.

DEV-083: DoctorDialog rebase-in-progress copy now leads with '保留笔记并中止 rebase' instead of the previous destructive default. User feedback 2026-09-22 reported 'content reverted → re-edit → conflict again → loop'; the root cause was that rebase --abort drops local commits.
Hardening: NO_AHEAD_TO_PRESERVE and PRESERVE_LOCAL_FAILED added to GitSyncDoctorError; execute() translates matching GitServiceError codes so the UI sees stable identifiers.
